historical_reviews.v3_1: A possible standards mapping cannot replace approved target effect, persistence and recovery.

original_test_intent: Set an as-yet-unconfirmed auxiliary-log status and validate the intended metadata/effect and restoration without suppressing real evidence.
original_method: Undefined in Master; no subsystem, log type, write payload, supported state, readback, side effect or recovery exists.
manual_activity: Engineer/vendor must define the exact controlled status, legitimate reason to change it, observable effect and restore path.
agent_execution_scope: After decision baseline, set one approved state, read back/evaluate and restore
engineer_actions: Own corrected acceptance and DUT verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek correctly refuses execution because a title and TBD body cannot authorize a logging-status write.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: None until the existing Auxiliary Log Status decision defines the OOB setter and restore contract.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: TBD body and timing remain unchanged.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: After approval, capture underlying log/status, validate an allowlisted payload, set once with confirmation, read back and prove intended effect, then restore.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Provides only a future safe framework; it does not invent bytes or semantics.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Setting generic MCA/OEM metadata without knowing the intended status cannot satisfy this testcase.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A guessed write could falsify health metadata, alter retention/alerts or conceal faults.

project_override_considerations: A vendor API is acceptable only after the controlled field and effect are authoritative; alternate tooling cannot resolve an undefined mutation.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title requires a state change, while Procedure/Criteria are wholly TBD and boilerplate proposes clearing evidence; V2's generic command family lacks approved target semantics.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Core state, payload, expected effect and recovery are all unresolved, exceeding normal Project readiness gaps.

review_improvement: Keeps the setter blocked consistently with the approved pending decision and prevents unauthorised health-metadata fabrication.
independent_technical_reasoning: Unlike the getter, this case can change diagnostic metadata that operators trust. Until the exact field, allowed values, coupling to underlying records and restoration semantics are approved, even a syntactically valid 0x5B payload cannot be judged safe or correct.
